The '''Office of the Caretaker''' was an office located in the [[Kesh capitol building]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Caretaker]] was the official keeper of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on Kesh. The office was in place by [[3000 BBY]], when [[Varner Hilts]] served as the Caretaker.
